svg.title: RACI matrix of an FMS project: owner, integrator, machine builder, IT and safety engineer per phase activity
svg.text: RACI matrix – who does what in an FMS project (example for a turnkey contract)
R = responsible (does the work), A = accountable (decides, signs; only one per row), C = consulted, I = informed. Empty = not involved.
P6 PLC / cell software + virtual commissioning
P6 MES / ERP side + master data
P7 FAT acceptance + punch list signature
P8 CE marking of the whole system
Example only. In a split contract (several suppliers) the owner becomes accountable for all interfaces and often for CE marking of the whole system.
